sentences.en: He displayed a kind of weak handsomeness, sporting long sideburns and a thin moustache above a sloping mouth.

sentences.en: Celebrity has grown in handsomeness and strength.

sentences.en: Choice materials, fashionable style, handsomeness in trimming, lightness of weight and the warmth afforded are the special features of garments made in Shanghai.
sentences.vi: Chất liệu lựa chọn, kiểu dáng thời trang, sự đẹp mắt trong cách cắt may, trọng lượng nhẹ và độ ấm vừa đủ là những điểm đặc biệt của hàng may mặc sản xuất tại Thượng Hải.

sentences.en: Incorporating magnificences, strangeness, danger, handsomeness, elegance and peacefulness, it is the rare magnificent rosy-cloud landform scenic spot in china.

sentences.en: Handsomeness nowadays has been a fashion, and "enjoying a handsome life" has been a slogan.

sentences.en: Amethyst rose symbolizes the strong image of handsomeness and activeness of women, who are traditionally called the JaneScalf heroines.

sentences.en: No, she just said my advantage was I was handsome, but my disadvantage was the handsomeness was not so obvious.

sentences.en: But he became a bad boy because of his handsomeness.
